library(tidyverse)
library(speedyseq)

dir.create("figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
theme_set(theme_classic())
anglelabs <- theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))

load("../data/micom_results.Rdata", verbose = TRUE)

# scp iris:/data1/collab004/isabl/data_lake/analyses/38/55/113855/merged/ micom-0.0.3-merged


growth <- growth_raw %>% select(growth_rate, taxon, sample, medium) %>%
  filter(taxon != "rare") %>%
  filter(medium!="agora_high_fiber") %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from = "growth_rate", names_from = "medium", values_fill = 0)  %>% 
  mutate(diff = agora_western_fiber_pulse - agora_western) %>% 
  group_by(taxon) %>% 
  summarize(
    median_diff = median(diff, na.rm = T),
    mean_diff = mean(diff, na.rm = T),
            n_pos_in_western = sum(agora_western > 0, na.rm = T),
            n_pos_in_pulse = sum(agora_western_fiber_pulse > 0, na.rm = T),
            n_samples = n_distinct(growth_raw$sample),
            prev_pct = round(n_pos_in_western / n_samples * 100, 1)
            ) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(n_pos_in_western > 10) %>% 
  arrange(desc(n_pos_in_western), desc(median_diff))





## joy plot different sitributions

ggplot(growth, aes(x=mean_diff, y=reorder(taxon, mean_diff), alpha = prev_pct )) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype="dashed") + 
  labs(x="Mean difference in simualted growth rate\nbetween western and western + extra fiber diets",
       alpha="Prevalence %\nacross 108 samples", y="Species") + 
  geom_point() +
  theme(text=element_text(size=12),
        legend.position=c(.7, .2))
ggsave(filename = "figures/rtr-micom-taxon-growth.pdf", width = 7, height=7)

ggplot(prod %>% filter(metabolite %in% scfas$metabolite) %>%

get_paired_stats <-  function(df, met, media = c("agora_western", "agora_western_fiber_pulse")){
  testdat <- df[df$metabolite ==met, ] 
  testdat <- testdat[testdat$medium %in% media, ]  %>% 
    select(sample, medium, flux) %>%
  pivot_wider (names_from = medium, values_from = flux, values_fill = 0) %>%
      data.frame()  
  return(list(
    "df"=testdat,
    "test"=BSDA::SIGN.test(testdat[, media[1]], testdat[, media[2]],  md = 0, conf.level = 0.95) 
  )
  )
}

(signtest_res_but <- get_paired_stats(prod, met="but_e", media = c("agora_western", "agora_western_fiber_pulse") ))
(signtest_res_ac <- get_paired_stats(prod, met="ac_e", media = c("agora_western", "agora_western_fiber_pulse") ))
(signtest_res_isoval <- get_paired_stats(prod, met="isoval_e", media = c("agora_western", "agora_western_fiber_pulse") ))
(signtest_res_ppa <- get_paired_stats(prod, met="ppa_e", media = c("agora_western", "agora_western_fiber_pulse") ))

# metabolite production ordination
```{R}
ordphy <-  micomphy %>% subset_samples(., medium != "agora_high_fiber")

library(microViz)
ordphy %>%
  ord_calc(method = "PCA") %>%
  ord_plot(color = "medium", plot_taxa = 1:10, size = 2, tax_lab_style = microViz::tax_lab_style(size=4)) +
  scale_colour_brewer(palette = "Dark2") + stat_ellipse(aes(group=medium, color=medium))


ggplot(prod %>% filter(metabolite %in% c("but_e")) %>% 
         filter(medium != "agora_high_fiber"), aes(x=medium, y=flux)) + geom_boxplot() + scale_y_log10() 



library(maaslin3)

glm_results <- maaslin3::maaslin3(
  input_metadata = data.frame(sample_data(ordphy)),
  input_data = as.matrix(data.frame(otu_table(ordphy))),formula = "~medium + (1 | sample)",
  output = "tmpmaaslin3",
  normalization = "NONE",min_abundance = 0, min_prevalence = 0, min_variance = 0,
)



```


## Genes vs production
```{r}
ids <- data.frame(sample_data(ordphy))$sample
mixed_solid_tumor <- readRDS("../data/mixed_solid_tumor.RDS") %>% 
  rename(sample=identifier.y)

scfa_data <- ordphy %>% 
  prune_taxa(scfas$metabolite, .) %>% 
  psmelt() %>% 
  inner_join(mixed_solid_tumor)

scfa_data_by_bug <- exchanges %>% 
  filter(metabolite %in% scfas$metabolite) %>% 
  inner_join(mixed_solid_tumor)
  

ggplot(scfa_data, aes(x=log_acoa, y=Abundance)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  facet_wrap(~OTU, scales="free") + 
  labs(y="MICOM production", x="log(acoa) gene abundance") 
  
ggplot(scfa_data_by_bug, aes(x=log_acoa, y=flux)) + 
  geom_point(alpha=.3) + 
  facet_wrap(~metabolite, scales="free") + 
  labs(y="MICOM flux, by bug", x="log(acoa) gene abundance") + scale_y_log10() +
  geom_smooth(method="lm")


ggplot(scfa_data_by_bug%>% 
         group_by(sample, metabolite, log_acoa ) %>% 
         summarize(flux=sum(flux)), aes(x=log_acoa, y=flux)) + 
  geom_point(alpha=.3) + 
  facet_wrap(~metabolite, scales="free") + 
  labs(y="MICOM summed export", x="log(acoa) gene abundance") + scale_y_log10() +
  geom_smooth(method="lm")

```
